'''Xig Rollem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Grathus]] who owned a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] near one of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] larger mud basins. He purchased a [[Supreme-Class Servant Droid|''Supreme''-class]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], which was sent to Grathus by mistake, and named it [[Threna]]. He then used it as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and bouncer at [[Xig Rollem's tavern|his cantina]], during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
